query: What is the exact Product SKU and NVPN part number for the NVIDIA H100 NVL card?
ground_truth_answer: The Product SKU is P1010 SKU 210 and the NVPN is 699-21010-0210-xxx.

query: What are the Base and Boost GPU clocks for the NVIDIA H100 NVL?
ground_truth_answer: Base clock is 1,080 MHz and Boost clock is 1,785 MHz.

query: What is the maximum default board power and compliance limit for H100 NVL when strapped for 450W or 600W power mode?
ground_truth_answer: 400 W maximum (default) and 310 W power compliance limit.

query: What is the peak memory bandwidth and memory bus width of the H100 NVL card?
ground_truth_answer: Peak memory bandwidth is 3,938 GB/s with a memory bus width of 6,016 bits.

query: What are the PCI Device ID, Vendor ID, and Sub-System ID for the NVIDIA H100 NVL?
ground_truth_answer: Device ID: 0x2321, Vendor ID: 0x10DE, Sub-System ID: 0x1839.

query: Which RISC-V general-purpose register is hard-wired to constant zero?
ground_truth_answer: Register x0 (ABI name zero) is hardwired to constant zero.

query: What is the ABI name, description, and saver rule for RISC-V register x1?
ground_truth_answer: ABI name is ra, description is Return address, and saver rule is Caller.

query: Who is responsible for saving registers x8 and x9 in RISC-V calling conventions?
ground_truth_answer: Registers x8 (s0/fp) and x9 (s1) are saved registers with Callee saver rule.

query: In RISC-V RV32I, which instruction format is used for conditional branch instructions?
ground_truth_answer: The B-type format (imm[12|10:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, imm[4:1|11], opcode).

query: What are the standard base integer register widths for RV32I and RV64I?
ground_truth_answer: RV32I registers are 32 bits wide; RV64I registers are 64 bits wide.

query: Under § 4 ArbZG, what is the mandatory minimum rest break for a daily working time of 8 hours, and what is the minimum permissible break interval?
ground_truth_answer: At least 30 minutes for a working time of 6 to 9 hours, divided into intervals of at least 15 minutes each.

query: What uninterrupted daily rest period is required following the end of work under § 5 ArbZG?
ground_truth_answer: An uninterrupted rest period of at least 11 hours is required.

query: Under § 14 KSchG, what FTE calculation weighting factor is assigned to an employee working 25 hours per week?
ground_truth_answer: Employees working more than 20 to 30 hours per week are factored at 0.75 FTE.
expected_section_or_clause: § 14 KSchG - Threshold of Application & Employee Headcount Weighting

query: What is the statutory minimum annual vacation days for an employee on a standard 5-day working week under § 3 BUrlG?
ground_truth_answer: 20 working days per calendar year (based on the statutory 24 working days for a 6-day week).

query: Under § 4 BUrlG, how long is the waiting period (Wartezeit) before an employee acquires full annual leave entitlement?
ground_truth_answer: The full statutory annual leave entitlement is acquired only after the employment relationship has existed continuously for 6 months.
expected_section_or_clause: § 4 BUrlG - Waiting Period for Full Vacation Entitlement
